original: 全く。\n真面目なんだか、自由奔放なんだか
traducao: Jeez.\nI can't tell if he's serious or carefree.

original: でも、とても\nウッドロウさんらしいと思いますわ
traducao: But, I think it is very\nfitting for Woodrow.

original: そうだな
traducao: Yeah.

original: 昔から、こうと決めたら\n引かないところのある人だったし
traducao: He's always been the type who won't\nback down once he's decided on something.

original: それ、あんたにだけは\n絶対言われたくないわね……
traducao: You're the last person\nwho should be saying that...

original: まあまあ
traducao: Now, now.

original: とにかく、この方のお人柄とご事情は\nとてもよくわかりました
traducao: Anyway, I understand this person's\ncharacter and circumstances very well.

original: あとは、誰がこの依頼を\n請け負うか、だけれど……
traducao: Now it's just a matter of who will\ntake on this request...

original: クエスト「賢王の遊説」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest "The Wise King's Tour" has been\nadded.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: あなたが引き受けてくれるのね。\nありがとう
traducao: You'll take it on, right?\nThank you.

original: ウッドロウさんは、俺達がとても\nお世話になった人で……
traducao: Woodrow is someone who took\nreally good care of us...

original: すごく大きな国の次期王様なんだけど、\nだからって、いばり散らしたりしない\n大らかで懐の深い人なんだ
traducao: He's the next king of a huge country,\nbut he doesn't boss people around.\nHe's very generous and open-minded.

original: きっと、○○も\n仲良くなれるんじゃないかな
traducao: I'm sure you'll get along great with him,\n○○.

original: そうねぇ。\nそれに、ああ見えて\n弓の腕前だってかなりのものだし
traducao: Yeah.\nAnd despite how he looks,\nhis archery skills are quite something.

original: 正直、護衛だの何だの\n気にし過ぎじゃないかと思うけど。\nま、立場上、しょうがないわよね
traducao: Honestly, I think they're overthinking\nthis whole escort thing.\nBut given his status, it can't be helped.

original: 私達でお手伝い出来る事があれば、\nぜひ声をかけて下さいね
traducao: If there's anything we can help with,\nplease let us know.

original: 精一杯、協力させていただきます
traducao: We'll do our best to cooperate.

original: あなたなら、いつも通りにやれば大丈夫。\nだからあまり気負わずに、ね
traducao: You'll be fine if you just do as usual.\nSo don't stress yourself out too much.

original: それじゃ、気を付けて\n行ってらっしゃい
traducao: Well then, take care and\nhave a safe trip.

original: ……見つかってしまったか
traducao: ...I've been found out, huh.

original: すまないが、まだ城へ\n戻るわけにはいかないのだ
traducao: I'm sorry, but I can't return\nto the castle just yet.

original: 少しでも見聞を広め、\n国へ還元出来るものを得なければ
traducao: I must broaden my horizons and gain\nsomething to give back to my country.

original: それが今の私に出来る\n一番の務めだと思っている
traducao: I believe that is the most important\nduty I can fulfill right now.

original: 父上にそう伝えてくれたまえ
traducao: Please pass that on to my father.

original: また君か……
traducao: You again...

original: 言ったはずだ。\n私はまだ、国へ帰るつもりはないと
traducao: I thought I said it.\nI don't intend to return home yet.

original: ギルド……護衛？
traducao: A guild... escort?

original: ……どうやら、私は誤解をしていたらしい
traducao: ...It seems I've misunderstood.

original: すまないが、詳しく話を聞かせて\nもらえないだろうか
traducao: I apologize, but could you please\ntell me more about this?

original: なるほどな……、そういう事だったのか
traducao: I see... so that's how it is.

original: これは、一時の猶予を与えられたと\n受け取って構わないのかもしれないな
traducao: Perhaps I can take this as being\ngranted a temporary reprieve.

original: ……失礼。\n私ばかりが納得してしまったな
traducao: ...Forgive me.\nI was just convincing myself.

original: しかし、どうしたものか……私は一応、\n身分を隠し、各地を遊説している身でな
traducao: But what to do... I'm currently traveling\nincognito on a tour of various regions.

original: 公式に、ギルドの今回の申し出を\n受ける事は出来ないのだよ
traducao: I cannot officially accept the guild's\noffer this time.

original: それでは、身分を隠している意味が\nなくなってしまうからね
traducao: If I did, there would be no point in\nhiding my identity.

original: ……一つ、私に考えがあるのだが
traducao: ...I do have one idea, though.

original: どうだろう？\n私が、そのギルドへ身を寄せるというのは
traducao: How about this?\nWhat if I were to join your guild?

original: 表面上はどうあれ、腕に覚えのある者達と\n寝食を共にするのだ。\n国の者達も少しは安心出来よう
traducao: Regardless of appearances, I'd be living\nwith capable fighters.\nMy people back home would be reassured.

original: 何より、ギルドには民からの生の声が\n多く寄せられるはず
traducao: Above all, the guild must receive many\nraw voices from the people.

original: 私自身も、大いに学ばせてもらう事が\n出来そうだ。\n悪い案ではないと思うのだが
traducao: I feel I could learn a great deal\nfrom that experience as well.\nI don't think it's a bad idea.

original: ……そうだな。\n一度ギルドへ向かい、\n代表者と話をするのが筋だろう
traducao: ...You're right.\nIt makes sense to head to the guild first\nand speak with the representative.

original: 私はウッドロウ・ケルヴィン。\n君の名前は？
traducao: I am Woodrow Kelvin.\nAnd your name?

original: ……そうか。\n○○君というのだね
traducao: ...I see.\nSo you are ○○.

original: では、改めて案内、よろしく頼む
traducao: Well then, please lead the way.

original: ここがアドリビトム……
traducao: So this is Ad Libitum...

original: なるほど。\n国籍を問わず、多くの人間が集って\nいるというのは本当の様だな
traducao: I see.\nIt seems to be true that many people of\nall nationalities gather here.

original: ご苦労様。\n無事に帰ってきたのね
traducao: Good work.\nYou made it back safely.

original: ご無事で何よりです、ええと……
traducao: I'm glad you're safe, um...

original: ウッドロウで構わない。\nあまりかしこまらず、楽にしていてくれ
traducao: Woodrow is fine.\nPlease don't be so formal, be at ease.

original: わかりました。\nじゃあ、ウッドロウさん。\nわたしがこのギルドのリーダー、アンジュです
traducao: Understood.\nWell then, Woodrow.\nI am the leader of this guild, Ange.

original: よろしく頼む
traducao: It's a pleasure to meet you.

original: 早速で申し訳ないが、実は\n折り入って頼みたい事があるのだが……
traducao: I apologize for the suddenness, but I\nactually have a special favor to ask...

original: お話はわかりました。\nそういう事でしたら、わたし達は\n心からあなたを歓迎します
traducao: I understand what you're saying.\nIf that's the case, we welcome you from\nthe bottom of our hearts.

original: その代わり、みんなと同じ様に\n仕事もきっちりこなして頂きますが
traducao: In exchange, we'll expect you to do your\nwork properly, just like everyone else.

original: 構わない。\n元より、それがこちらの望みでもある
traducao: I don't mind.\nThat was my desire from the start.

original: ○○君、そういうわけだ。\nしばらくこちらで世話になる
traducao: So that's how it is, ○○.\nI'll be in your care for a while.

original: 何かあれば、\n遠慮なく呼び付けてくれ
traducao: If anything comes up,\ndon't hesitate to call on me.

original: ウッドロウがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Woodrow joined Ad Libitum.
